decisions.reason: A formwork profile line close to the core offer, presented on its own page, fits established customers and gives no sign of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses.
Automated flow control supports the firm's strategic push into automation, and R&D slack lets it carry the product while early results remain uncertain.
Shuttering magnets are a standard consumable for precast plants with low carrying cost, and only a website mention is not enough evidence of underperformance to justify dropping it.
Magnetic formwork strips sit close to the core business, have their own page, and likely meet aspirations through cross-selling to existing plant customers.
A dedicated page signals management commitment, and the component complements the magnetic formwork portfolio at low cost.
As a lightly promoted variant it carries some risk of being consolidated into the line, but low resource use and a 2018 boom in construction demand reduce the pressure to drop it.
